name: ibol-open-learning
display_name: IBOL Open Learning: Albert Tan Sin Hon
description: Read-only citation, lesson and question tools for Insurance-Backed Offshore Liquidity.
long_description: An author-commissioned companion to the University of Groningen Press open-access book. Guide search covers original teaching materials. Full-book search requires a separately downloaded, checksum-verified local publisher-PDF cache. The book legal cut-off is 1 August 2026. No account or API key is required. Uses the UV runtime to install locked Python dependencies; no universal desktop-host compatibility is claimed.
